title: Free-diffusion limit — DiffusionForce vs RandomMotionForce
caption: Mean squared displacement of 144 non-interacting walkers under mainline DiffusionForce (coral, ±SEM) against the analytic 4·D·t line the paper's RandomMotionForce also follows (D = xi = 0.1).
interpretation: Measured MSD 0.383 vs theory 0.400 (z = −0.56) — a match. The calibration scaling = xi·radius makes DiffusionForce a sound substitute in the free limit (OS, VM).
